Emma (CSM): Kicking off Palomino onboarding — scheduled kickoff Wed 2026-04-07 15:00 PT. Shared agenda here: https://docs.redwood.ai/palomino/kickoff (please confirm attendees).

Raj (CS Ops): I'll own infra checklist and account setup. Will need customer EKS cluster access + KMS role by EOD Monday. Risk: cert provisioning lag.

Priya (SolutionsEng): Happy to run two workshops: 1) API integration (45m), 2) Ops & monitoring (30m). Prefer Thu morning. @Carlos can you confirm dev env readiness?

Carlos (Palomino PM): Thanks. Dev env is partially ready — Maya will finish data dump by Tue. We can do Thu morning for workshops. We need SSO + SCIM configured before prod.

Maya (Palomino Eng): Data dump ETA Tue 03:00 PT. Note: some user metadata fields missing (phone, dept). We'll sync mapping during workshop.

Emma (CSM): Success criteria (short): - API integration demo with sample traffic - SSO + SCIM working for 10 pilot users - Dashboard showing token usage and latency < 200ms for 95th pct - Training completed with 3 Palomino power users.

Raj (CS Ops): Draft onboarding checklist:
```
- Account & billing set up
- KMS/HSM access verified
- VPC peering or VPN configured
- Test dataset ingested (by Palomino)
- SSO/SCIM test users created
- Observability dashboards provisioned
```
I'll post this to the ticket.

Emma (CSM): Timeline: Week0 kickoff -> Week1 integrations & workshops -> Week2 pilot validation -> Week3 go/no-go. Renewal risk: none flagged yet but if data ingestion slips >1 week, escalate to AM.

Carlos (Palomino PM): Can we add a 1-2 day buffer for data cleanup? Also request a short recording of the API workshop for internal enablement.

Priya (SolutionsEng): We'll record both workshops and share slides. Action: @Maya to add sample schemas to the shared drive (link: https://drive.google.com/palomino-schemas).

Emma (CSM): Actions recap: 1) Raj -> infra checklist + KMS request by Mon 2) Maya -> data dump Tue + schemas 3) Priya -> schedule workshops Thu AM + record 4) Emma -> prep success metrics dashboard. Owning parties added in the kickoff doc. :thumbsup: 

onboard-bot: Meeting created: Wed 2026-04-07 15:00 PT. Agenda attached. Reminder set 24h before.
